units: <cite ref="Berakhot 60b:3">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> (in a night prayer) <he>המפיל … ות׳ וכ׳</he> who causes the bands of sleep to fall upon my eyes, and slumber on my eye-lids; <cite ref="Berakhot 60b:6">ib.</cite> (in a morning prayer) <he>המעביר … ות׳ וכ׳</he> who causes the bands of sleep to pass away from my eyes, and slumber from my eye-lids.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 287">Yalk. Ex. 287</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01312"><he>שַׁלִּיט</he></cite>; (Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 6 <cite ref="N00369"><he>נוּמָה</he></cite>); a. e.
